welcome_desc: Your one stop application for everything Godot.
onboard_empty_projects: No folders added yet, GodotHub won't find any existing projects until you add one, or you can add projects manually later.
onboard_empty_versions: No folders added yet, new Godot downloads will go to the app data folder unless you set one below.
onboard_no_template_folder: No folder set, you can always configure this later in Settings, or save templates manually.
onboard_cloud_desc: Already have a backup? Sign in with GitHub and restore your workspaces, projects, and settings from a gist.
discovery_scanning_installs: Looking for Godot on your PATH and in Steam…
discovery_link_hint: Projects are linked to a matching Godot version automatically, including versions you add in the next step.
setup_title: How do you want to use GodotHub?
setup_desc: Pick a starting point. Anything you leave out is hidden and never loads, so GodotHub stays quick. You can change this anytime in Settings, under Behavior.
first_workspace_desc: A workspace holds your projects, categories, and settings. Give this one a name and a look that feels like yours, you can add more later.
basics_desc: Pick your language, bring back a cloud backup if you have one, and choose whether Discord shows what you're working on.
found_desc: Here's everything GodotHub found on this machine. Taking you in now.
